create_visualizer_opencv: create an OpencvBackendVisualizer instance with opencv backend for drawing on images
set_image_visualizer: set an RGB numpy array image on the visualizer to prepare for drawing
draw_circles_opencv: draw filled circles on the image with configurable center, radius, face color, and alpha transparency
draw_texts_opencv: draw text labels on the image at specified positions with configurable font size, color, and bounding box
draw_bboxes_opencv: draw bounding boxes on the image with configurable edge colors and line widths using mmcv
